title: Temporal Analysis of NetFlow Datasets for Network Intrusion Detection Systems
abstract: arXiv:2503.04404v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper investigates the temporal analysis of NetFlow datasets for machine learning (ML)-based network intrusion detection systems (NIDS). Although many previous studies have highlighted the critical role of temporal features, such as inter-packet arrival time and flow length/duration, in NIDS, the currently available NetFlow datasets for NIDS lack these temporal features. This study addresses this gap by creating and making publicly available a set of NetFlow datasets that incorporate these temporal features [1]. With these temporal features, we provide a comprehensive temporal analysis of NetFlow datasets by examining the distribution of various features over time and presenting time-series representations of NetFlow features. This temporal analysis has not been previously provided in the existing literature. translated_title: 面向网络入侵检测系统的NetFlow数据集时序分析
translated_abstract: 本文研究了基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统（NIDS）中NetFlow数据集的时序分析。尽管以往许多研究已经强调了时间特征（如数据包到达间隔时间和流长度/持续时间）在NIDS中的关键作用，但目前可用于NIDS的NetFlow数据集却缺乏这些时间特征。本研究通过创建并公开提供一组包含这些时间特征的NetFlow数据集来填补这一空白。借助这些时间特征，我们通过考察各种特征随时间的分布并呈现NetFlow特征的时间序列表示，对NetFlow数据集进行了全面的时序分析。这种时序分析在此前的现有文献中尚未被提供过。此外，我们还借鉴了信号处理中的时频分析思想，并对其进行了测试，以观察时频……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次创建并公开了包含数据包到达间隔、流持续时间等时间特征的NetFlow数据集，为网络入侵检测系统提供了前所未有的全面时序分析，并引入信号处理中的时频分析方法进行探索。
en_tdlr: This paper creates and publicly releases NetFlow datasets incorporating temporal features (such as inter-packet arrival time and flow duration) for ML-based network intrusion detection systems, providing the first comprehensive temporal analysis of NetFlow datasets and introducing time-frequency analysis from signal processing.
